name: all_depths_and_low_values
description: Every global depth; saturated, half-intensity, cutoff, black, near-saturated rows.

name: overlaps_and_ties
description: All ordered depth pairs across seven hue sectors, equal/unequal and saturated amplitudes; duplicate-voxel writes use last value.

name: six_way_overlaps
description: Seed 20260907; six distinct global depths at each pixel, multiple colour-order transitions.

name: empty
description: No foreground; output must be exactly black.

name: axis_landmarks
description: Asymmetric XYZ landmarks; no transpose, X/Y mirror or Z reversal.

name: upstream_reversed
description: Upstream reverse option performs Z reverse AND horizontal flip before colouring.

name: projection_subrange
description: Slice subset must retain full-stack LUT denominator and global colours.

name: uint16_conversion
description: ImageJ 16-bit scaling boundaries and clipping; little-endian raw input.

name: signal_plus_mask
description: Intensity > 30 after conversion; mask excludes x=7 despite bright signal.

name: binary_mask
description: Same support as signal_plus_mask, explicit 255 inside; no amplitude inferred from absent signal.

name: crop_global
description: Nonzero XYZ crop offset, overlapping ray; zero-pad before reference coding.

name: crop_full_equivalent
description: Identical voxels expressed directly in full template grid; must equal crop_global.

name: canvas_corners
description: Exact full-canvas corner placement and depth orientation.

name: rgb_projection_ties
description: Direct RGB diagnostic: tied channels, strict tertiary inequality, saturated first-hit and pixel traversal; only projection plugin runs.

name: real_template_crop
description: CC-BY-4.0 FlyLight neuropil template tissue crop, NOT a segmented driver-line neuron.

name: crop_reversed_storage
description: Same physical/index crop with reversed X and Z storage; explicit signed index mapping restores the same full-canvas RGB.

name: crop_signal_mask
description: Cropped signal plus co-indexed binary mask; masked-out overlap cannot alter the output.

name: crop_binary_mask
description: Same cropped mask without signal: 255 inside the mask at original global depths.

name: intensity_depth_matrix
description: Every 8-bit amplitude at every depth; voxel[z,intensity,z]=intensity, all others zero. Input gzip mtime=0.

name: uint16_nonzero_lower_endpoint
description: Explicit nonzero lower endpoint: subtract and clip, half-up conversion, encoder cutoff, upper clipping.

name: threshold_254
description: Strict converted-intensity threshold at the top of the uint8 range; surviving amplitude is retained.

name: threshold_255
description: Strict converted-intensity threshold at the top of the uint8 range; surviving amplitude is retained.
